content: “Ta ishato! Ta aawato! Ta bolla wordo woththidayssas ta intes immiza zaaro siyite!”
Izi Ayhudata qaalara haasayishin siydi kaseppe asay co7u gides; Phawuloosikka haasaya gujjidi hizgides.

“Tani Kilqiya giddon diza Xarseese kataman yeeletida Ayhuda asa; tani dicciday gidikko hannin Yerusalamena; ta nu aawata woga wursa Gamalyaaleppe lo7etha tamaradissenne inte hach ooththizayssatho Xoossas suure woznappe ooththashe de7adis.
Hayssa ha ogeza kaalliza asata ubba wodhana gakkanaas goodaththiza asakkoshin; macatanne addeta qacha qacha qasho keeththe yeddizadekkoshin.

Hayssi wuri tumu gididayssa Qeeseta halaqatinne dere cimatikka wuri taas markattana; haray attoshin Damasqon diza ammaniza asa qacha Yerusalame ehada qaxayssanas Damasqon dizaytas xaafetida dabdaabe Qeeseta halaqataappenne dere cimatappe ekkadis.
Phawuloosi Kirstoosa wosti ammanidakko yootides
“Tani Damasqo bishininne katama gelana matishin seeta gallas ta qopponta dishin saloppe wolqama poo7oy tana yuuy aadhdhi poo7ides.
He wode tani biitta bolla kundada Sawule! Sawule! Ne tana aazas goodday? giza qaala siyadis.
Takka ‘Godo ne oonee?’ gadis; izikka ‘Ta neni gooddiza Naazirete Yesusa’ gides.
Tanara issife diza asati poo7oza beyida attin izi tanara haasayishin qaala siybetenna.
Takka ‘Godo ta ayy ooththoo?’ gadis. Godayka ‘Dendada Damasqo ba, ne ooththanayssa isti nees heen yootana’ gides.
Poo7oza xolqetetha daroppe dendidayssan ta xeellanas dandayabekke; tanara diza asati ta kushe oykki goochchidi tana Damasqo gaththida.
“Hananiya geetettiza issadey heen dees; Hananiyay Damasqon diza Ayhudata achchan daro galattettidayssanne woga bonchiza asa.
Izi ta ach shiiqi eqqidi ‘Ta isha Sawule ne ayfey qasseka xeello’ gides; heerakka ta ayfey iza xeellides.
Izikka tana ‘Nu aawanta Xoossi ne iza shene erana mala, iza xilloza ne beyana malanne izi gizayssa ne siyana mala nena kaseti doorides.
Izi hessa ooththiday ne beyidayssanne siyidayssa asa ubba sinthan izas ne markattanassa.
Histin ha7i aazas gam7ay? Dendada iza sunth xeeygada xammaqeta; ne nagarappekka meeceta’ gides.
Hessafe guye ta Yerusalame simmada Xoossa keeththan woossishin ajjutay taas beettides.
Godayka taas qoncidi ‘Ne ta gish immana markateth isti ekkonta gish ne gam7onta dashe Yerusalameppe ellela keza!’ gides.
Takka izas ‘Godo ta Ayhudata Woosa Keeththati dizaso baada nena ammanizayta ubba qachada ista bukkidayssa ba baggara istika eretes.
Ne gish markatiza Istifanoose asay wodhiza wode takka he wodhiza asata achchan eqqada isti wodhizayssa takka dosadissenne wodhizayta may7okka naagadis’ gides.
Godayka ‘Hahon diza Ayzaabetakko ta nena kiittiza gish dendada ba!’ ” gides.
Phawuloosi Oroome dere as gididayssa qoncisides
Asay hinno gakkanaas Phawuloosa haasaya woznappe lo7ethi siyishe aggidi ba qaala dhoqu histidi “Hayssa mala asi nu biittafe dhayo; hayssa mala asi nu biittan shempora daanas bessena” gishe waassides.
Asay waassishe ba may7o qaari qaari wuxxishenne biitta pude salo dharcides.
Mato halaqazi hessa beyidi Phawuloosa wotadarati dizaso gelthana mala azazides; dereyka iza bolla aazas hessa mala waassizakko erana mala iza garafidi paaxisana mala azazides.
Gido attin dafon waaxi qachidi iza garafana giigetishin Phawuloosi ba achchan eqqida issi mato halaqas “Oroome as pirday baynda garafanas intes fiiqadey dizee?” gides.
Mato halaqay hessa siyida mala gede halaqata azazizayssakko biidi “Ay ooththana gay? hayssi addezi Oroome asakko!” gides.
Hessa gish halaqata azazizayssi Phawuloosakko shiiqidi “Ane taas yoota, ne Oroome asee?” gides; izikka “Ee ta Oroome asa” gides.
Azazizaysikka “Ta Oroome asa gidanas daro miishe qanxada shaamadis” giin Phawuloosi “Tani gidikko Oroomen yelettadis” gides.
Hessa gish iza maramaranas giigettida asati heerakka iza achchafe haakkida; azazizaysikka izi Oroome as sansalatan qachidayssa yuush qoppidi babbides.
Phawuloosi Ayhudata duulata sinth shiiqides

Wontetha gallas azazizayssi Ayhudati Phawuloosa mootiza ayfe yo7oy azakkonne eranas koyides; Qeeseta halaqatinne Ayhudata shango duulata asay wuri issadeykka attonta kumeth shiiqana mala azazides; Phawuloosakka qashoppe birshidi shiiqida asa sinth shiishshi essides.
